name: Maggran Earthbinder
summary: At Sun Rock Retreat, Maggran Earthbinder guards a Horde camp in the Stonetalon Mountains. Cairne Bloodhoof sent the battle-worn tauren to lead its defense against beasts and harpies.

sections.title: A Veteran's Haven
sections.body: High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof sent Maggran Earthbinder to the Stonetalon Mountains to lead Sun Rock Retreat. Countless skirmishes and bloody campaigns have hardened his heart, stripping away the gentleness natural to his people. The outpost was also meant to offer him respite, where warm winds and mountain sunshine might ease his battle-worn spirit.

sections.title: Threats in the Crags
sections.body: Peace remains scarce in Stonetalon. From Sun Rock Retreat, Maggran coordinates defenses against Bloodfury harpies nesting in the peaks and gathers fighters to face predators across the crags. He once survived an ambush by the giant spider Besseleth, and knows how deadly the wilderness can be. He often enlists travelers to kill regional predators before they overrun the outpost.

faq.answer: Maggran Earthbinder commands the tauren at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. Cairne Bloodhoof stationed him there after countless battles to guard the settlement and secure its supply roads and borders.

faq.q: Why was Maggran sent to Sun Rock Retreat?
faq.answer: Cairne Bloodhoof appointed Maggran to lead Sun Rock Retreat for his seasoned military leadership and to give him a place of respite. A lifetime of combat has worn him down, and the quiet mountain sun offers some healing.

faq.q: What threats does Maggran ask adventurers to deal with?
faq.answer: Maggran directs defenses against Bloodfury harpies in the mountains and sends fighters after dangerous regional predators. The giant spider Besseleth is among them, after Maggran narrowly survived an ambush by her.

faq.q: What happened between Maggran and Besseleth?
faq.answer: Maggran survived an ambush by the giant spider Besseleth. He escaped with his life and now sends capable adventurers to kill her before others fall victim to her web.

faq.q: Does Maggran have a role in Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: Maggran answers to Cairne Bloodhoof, Thunder Bluff's High Chieftain. Though stationed at Sun Rock Retreat, his authority and orders come from the capital.

faq.q: Is Maggran Earthbinder friendly to Alliance players?
faq.answer: No. Maggran leads the Horde and is hostile to Alliance adventurers who enter Sun Rock Retreat.

angles.text: As a tauren, you can see in Maggran the toll warfare takes on the shu'halo spirit. Conflict can harden even the most grounded children of the Earth Mother.
As a Horde traveler on Stonetalon's steep climbs, you can look to Maggran to coordinate local patrols and keep supply routes clear of beasts and harpies.
